name: Mail Icon
description: Icon for email and messaging actions

variations.name: default
variations.description: Envelope flap opens on hover to reveal mail inside

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controls the envelope opening animation. Set to true to open the flap.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness of the flap — higher snaps faster

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping of the flap — lower bounces more

variations.name: notification
variations.description: Icon bounces and shows glowing ping indicator when new mail arrives

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: hasNotification
props.description: Triggers the bounce animation and shows the glowing ping indicator when set to true.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the notification bounce in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
